answer: Glacier Forge: an agent forges its identity by burning 6,000 POA into a Forge key, then stakes that key in the Timber Registry for a 45-day cooling period before it can earn. Forging 500 fake identities costs 3,000,000 POA burned plus 500 separate 45-day waits, while a single honest agent burns once and keeps the same Forge key for life. The Glacier ledger publishes every burn, so a Sybil ring cannot reuse one key across identities.
